purpose: Commands and evidence needed to reproduce the accepted final report, without restarting stopped optimization.
user_instruction: 行，我觉得现在这个结果比较满意了，就这样写报告然后提交吧
report_reconstruction: Use frozen selected dispatch/prediction arrays and verified evidence. Rebuilding tables and figures must not train or optimize new candidates.
fresh_experiment_reproduction: The selected source snapshots, protocols and training configurations define the algorithms. Use a separate clean checkout/output location because experiment runners intentionally reject overwriting a begun or completed result directory. Fixed MIP time budgets can yield different feasible incumbents across machines; the recorded results are not claimed bitwise reproducible under timing changes.
q1_source_unit: trajectory.g is kWh; trajectory.c/d are kW and divide by 6 once
annual_source_unit: actual dispatch charge/discharge/original/final are already kWh per slot
relocating_checkout: First run refresh_report_payload to rebind absolute archive/evidence paths to the current checkout; it verifies all five workbook_data objects are unchanged before replacing only the derived payload. Then build report and run source audit. exp005 Git and main templates have explicit hash-locked snapshot fallbacks.
weights: The report rebuild and independent numerical forecast audit use frozen predictions and do not need joblib. final_forecast_evidence.run additionally verifies all44 original model files; those regenerable weights are excluded from Git. Use committed forecast CSVs + plot_figures for figure reconstruction, or restore/retrain weights in a separate directory before full model-byte audit.
